title: Chapter 6169: Slay The Heaven With This Meager Power?

Chapter 6169: Slay The Heaven With This Meager Power?

Chapter 6169: Slay The Heaven With This Meager Power?

Fear was instinctive for all cultivators, including primal ancestors, when facing a tribulation. However, the slash split it open and made it explode, creating an unforgettable spectacle for the spectators.

“Clank!” The world and the sword domain seemingly became minuscule as were the living beings within.

“Is the high heaven dead?” Someone remarked after seeing the slash in the sky tearing through everything.

Who could stop a slash capable of severing the high heaven?

“Immortal Slays Heaven…” Everyone felt their soul leaving their body while wondering if the monstrous Li Qiye could block it. Would his head roll on the ground?

“It’s over if he can’t block it.” A desolate god said.

“Bam!” The blade suddenly stopped in midair.

Li Qiye turned out just fine because he successfully gripped the blade between his palms.

“Go!” Transcendent burned his true blood, adding more power to the formation and causing more shadows of an immortal sword to appear amidst the six dao.

Alas, the formation at its limit still couldn’t break free from Li Qiye’s grip. It couldn’t move an inch while pulsing with dazzling radiance, losing initiative and becoming helpless like a fish on the chopping board.

Everyone could sense the apocalyptic power emanating from the formation but it couldn’t do anything to Li Qiye.

“Slay the heaven? With such meager power? It’s a mere fantasy for those who have never seen it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

Everyone became frozen including Transcendent. If this slash couldn’t come close, then they couldn’t possibly imagine the power of the high heaven.

Alas, he had no time to think because Li Qiye easily broke the blade by shifting his grip. He then swung the blade and severed the sword domain. The eternal six dao and everything else were cut down in the blink of an eye.

Of course, Transcendent couldn’t escape this fate either.

His eyes were wide open as he observed the slash and murmured: “Such a heavenly slash, worth…”

He couldn’t finish his sentence because he fell to the ground, split into two pieces. His dao fruits, anima tree, and limit path - all were ended by the slash, resulting in a true death.

Once Li Qiye made up his mind, he showed no mercy. Nevertheless, Transcendent could still have a proper burial, unlike the other apex emperors who were utterly erased.

“Rumble!” The formation crumbled and the domain dispersed. The rebuilt dynasty also shattered back into ruins.

Everything felt like a dream but it was reality.

“Still the end.” Many big shots became emotional while watching the second collapse.

“Well, as long as Immortal Suppressor is alive, it can be rebuilt.” An emperor shook her head and reminded the crowd.
